units: Snh. 108ᵇ; a. fr.—בֶּן נֹחַ, pl. בְּנֵי נֹחַ Noahide, the human race; מצוות ב׳ נ׳ laws obligatory upon all mankind, contrad. to such as bind Israelites alone, universal laws.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:4">Tosef. Ab. Zar. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 9:4">IX</cite>), 4 <he>על … נצטוו בני נ׳</he> the gentiles have been commanded seven laws, namely, concerning justice, idolatry &c.; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 56a:24">Snh. 56ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 56b:22">Ib. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>כל האמור … בן נח וכ׳</he> the gentile stands forewarned concerning all that is said in the section on sorcery (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:10-12">Deut. XVIII, 10–12</cite>); Tosef. l. c. 6.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 59a:11">Snh. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>כל מצוה שנאמרה לב׳ נ׳ וכ׳</he> whatever law has been published for the Noahides (prior to the Sinaitic legislation) and repeated at Sinai &c. Tosef. l. c. 8.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 64b:8">Ab. Zar. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שקיבל … ב׳ נ׳</he> (a gentile entitled to citizenship in Palestine) is he who obligates himself to observe the seven Noachidic laws, v. <cite ref="C01225"><he>גֵּר</he></cite>; a. v. fr.
